_provenance.source: ERCOT 60-Day SCED Disclosure Gen Resource Data, scoped sample days (ERCOT-74/75/86 intake), PWRSTR rows, delivery years 2024-2025
_provenance.method: per-interval above-LSL discharge segments (max(LSL,0) -> min(step MW, HASL)) of the SCED2 offer curve of ONLINE (ON/ONREG/ONFFRRRS/FRRSUP) PWRSTR resources; MW-weighted quantile ladders of segment price in TWO bases (absolute $/MWh and the wall's gas-day multiple), within (net-load-percentile bin x hour block)
_provenance.driver: system net-load percentile within year (EIA-930 demand - wind - solar), forward-native -- the wall/pool driver
_provenance.rule19_boundary: the HASL cap excludes AS-responsibility MW, so this surface prices only the energy headroom the measured AS-award stack (ercot_storage_as_reserve / _product_credit / _deployment) leaves to energy; the incumbent occupant of the DISCHARGE PRICE row is the flat residual-identified battery_dispatch_adder ($10/MWh on the ERCOT keeper), which any arm must REPLACE, never stack on
_provenance.year_scope: 2024/2025 only -- no 2023 SCED corpus is on disk (NP3-965 full-year upload purged 2026-07-22; re-upload OWNER-DECLINED 2026-08-02), and rule 13 bars back-casting a 2024/25 surface onto 2023's regime
_provenance.corpus_caveat: scoped sample days: coverage is DISCLOSED per cell (intervals/days/resources), never silently pooled
